newsitem.title: PERU: Repsol reported buying Peru's Lima Gas.
newsitem.headline: Repsol reported buying Peru's Lima Gas.

text.p: Repsol has bought 60 percent of Peru's Lima Gas for $9 million, increasing the Spanish company's grip on the local natural gas market, leading daily El Comercio reported Tuesday.

Lima Gas officials refused to comment on the report, which quoted sources close to the deal. Repsol representatives in Lima were unavailable for comment, while the company's press office in Madrid said it was not aware of the purchase.
El Commercio's report followed Monday's announcement from Madrid that Repsol had bought a 60 percent stake in Peru's largest supplier of natural gas, Solgas, for $39 million.
Solgas has a 40 percent share in the domestic gas market. Lima Gas is the country's second largest supplier, but company officials would not say how large a market share it had.
Repsol, which started its operations in Peru in 1993, said in November it was planning to invest $230 million in Peru over the next five years.
